[{"insert":"Strict Bar Dip Progression

This is the last dip session, done in a descending 5, 3, 2 rep format, with the effort climbing across the six sets. The first three sets set a moderate baseline, then the last three push into heavier or harder territory. As the reps drop, make the dips harder by adding weight or using less assistance. This is your heaviest dip work of the whole cycle.
"}]
